# generate_image_tool

> Generate a NEW raster image (illustration, hero artwork, icon art, photo-real scene, texture, product mock) from a text prompt using the workspace's image mo...

|---|---|

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Generate a NEW raster image (illustration, hero artwork, icon art, photo-real scene,
texture, product mock) from a text prompt using the workspace's image model
(Google Gemini Image / OpenAI Images — whichever is configured, tried in order).
The image is saved as an LlmImage and AUTOMATICALLY ATTACHED to the conversation.

USE THIS FOR artwork. Do NOT use it for anything that must contain exact copy,
exact brand hex colours, a logo lockup or a specific canvas size (LinkedIn banner
1512x256, 1080x1080 post…): image models mis-spell text and drift colours. For
those, generate the ARTWORK here (say "no text" in the prompt), then place it with
run_python_skill `brand_composition` as an {{asset:...}} slot and set the type,
colours and logo in HTML. That two-step is how a finished marketing asset is made.

PROMPTING: describe subject, composition, lighting, medium and mood in one or two
sentences. `style: "brand"` (default) prepends the workspace brand palette/notes.
Pass `reference_llm_file_ids` for style/subject references (images you or the user
attached), or `edit_llm_file_id` to modify an existing image with the prompt.

MOCKUPS AND SCENES (billboard, poster on a wall, phone/laptop screen, packaging,
trade-show stand): these CAN carry the logo and copy inside the image — set
`include_brand_logo: true` (the workspace logo is attached as the first reference
and the model is told to reproduce it exactly), put the exact copy in quotes in
the prompt, use `quality: "high"`. Then LOOK at the result: image models still
mis-spell and mangle logos sometimes — check every word and the logo before
delivering, and re-roll once if anything is off.

RULES: always end your reply with the markdown link this tool returns; report the
provider/model and cost it returns if the user asks; if it errors with a setup
message, relay that message verbatim (an admin must add a key) — do not retry.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | What to draw. Subject, composition, lighting, medium, mood. Add "no text" unless text is wanted. |
| `aspect_ratio` | string | no | Canvas ratio (default 1:1). 16:9/21:9 for wide hero art, 4:1 or 8:1 for banner backgrounds (Google only), 9:16 for stories. One of: `1:1`, `3:2`, `2:3`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `4:5`, `5:4`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `21:9`, `4:1`, `8:1`. |
| `resolution` | string | no | Long-edge size: 1K (default, cheapest), 2K, 4K. One of: `1K`, `2K`, `4K`. |
| `quality` | string | no | draft = fastest/cheapest, high = best (default standard). One of: `draft`, `standard`, `high`. |
| `style` | string | no | "brand" (default) prepends the workspace brand palette and style notes; "free" sends the prompt as-is. One of: `brand`, `free`. |
| `transparent` | boolean | no | Request a transparent background (PNG). Supported by OpenAI; ignored elsewhere. |
| `reference_llm_file_ids` | array of integer | no | Up to 4 image LlmFile ids used as style/subject references. |
| `include_brand_logo` | boolean | no | Attach the workspace brand-kit logo as the first reference image and tell the model to reproduce it exactly (mockups, scenes). |
| `edit_llm_file_id` | integer | no | An existing image LlmFile to EDIT according to the prompt. |
| `provider` | string | no | Pin a provider (default: configured order). One of: `google`, `openai`. |
| `title` | string | no | Title for the saved file (default: derived from the prompt). |
| `directory_path` | string | no | Virtual folder for the file (default "/skills/images"). |
